 Julianne Hough turns heads in Valentino dress for DWTS 35 semifinals
 Josh Sanchez Wed, November 18, 2026 at 12:25 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Julianne Hough turns heads in Valentino dress for DWTS 35 semifinals We are less than one hour away from the Dancing with the Stars season 35 semifinals, and co-host Julianne Hough is suited up and ready for a show.
 Earlier in the night, Hough posed alongside co-host Alfonso Ribeiro in a cute black miniskirt , but nobody could have been ready for the look she was preparing to break out in full glam for showtime.
 Hough showed off the look on social media, strutting through the backstage halls in a sheer Valentino dress. When the lights turn on in primetime, Hough will be ready to go.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Let's hope the celebrities and their pro dance partners are just as ready for the spotlight, because they will need to perform two routines each.
 MORE: Julianne Hough brings vintage Hollywood beauty to 'Dancing with the Stars' Dedication Night 
 Julianne Hough Turns Backstage Into Personal Runway
 That is how you make an entrance.
 Hough is rocking the sheer pink dress from Italian luxury fashion house Valentino for the big night, with a high-slit for extra flow and movement across the stage. Fans were immediately loving the look and flying to the comments section to share their thoughts.
 " COME ON BALLETCORE PINK ," one fan enthusiastically shouted in the comments section. Another fan called it their "favorite hair and dress" of the season .
 While Hough may have been roasted for some of her previous looks this season, it's safe to say that the semifinal get-up is an instant hit.
 Advertisement Advertisement New episodes of Dancing With The Stars will air weekly every Tuesday night live on ABC and Disney+ beginning at 8:00 p.m. ET, with next-day streaming available on Hulu. The season finale will air on Tuesday, November 24.
